text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference before the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), Fuji Kiseki enlivens the 
atmosphere with a slick magic trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her doubts cleared away, Fuji Kiseki 
gave a dignified smile. She then promised 
to deliver top-tier entertainment that 
would forever remain in people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has clearly figured out what 
she needs to do. With firm confidence in 
her heart, she heads toward the race—
